verdict.rationale: Blink documents a bundled local `grep` command (docs-4), which gives basic regex search over file content from its own shell. That is only a thin mention, and the shell has no pipes for chaining filters (gh-8). The VS Code / Codespaces connection belongs to an external host editor and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: fuzzy matching, search filters, code-aware navigation (jump to file or symbol), documentation of grep's regex options, and hands-on corroboration.
